record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PASTEL_VEIL (passive NONE in the catalog). Shared strategy; they differ by stars and stats.
record.summary: Dash-and-shield: the caster picks the ALLY farthest from it (distanceM, strictly greater, caster excluded) and the free cell adjacent to that ally that is farthest from the caster, collects every same-team entity (including the caster) on the supercover line from its own cell to that cell, moves (swaps) to the destination, then each collected ally gets all negative-status cooldowns cleared and a shield of 20 / 40 / 80 / 160 by the caster's stars (fallback 160), scaled by the caster's AP (x(1 + AP/100)) and the cast crit, halved if the receiver is enraged, +25 % (rounded down) if the receiver holds Big Eater Belt. If no destination exists (no ally other than the caster, or no free cell found) the caster does not move and only the caster is cleansed and shielded. The line is collected before the move, so the caster's own start cell is in the set and the shield lands on the caster at its new cell.

targeting.who: no cast target is used (requiresTarget false; the target argument only feeds the suppressed default animation). The destination is chosen by Board.getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace(pokemon, true).
targeting.note: Ties on distance keep the first ally in board forEach order. Retained-selectedCell quirk: selectedCell is not cleared when a later, farther ally has no free adjacent cell, so the destination can be a free cell next to an EARLIER (less far) ally; the closest-available-place fallback is used only if no cell was ever selected. The MERCILESS effect in isTargettableBy can also admit low-HP enemies (hp <= 10) as candidates even with targetEnemies false.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's cell to the destination cell; the destination is a free cell adjacent to the farthest ally
geometry.cellsCollected: all on-board cells crossed including start and end; only cells holding a same-team entity matter

declaredRaw.destination: free cell adjacent to the farthest ally, farthest from the caster

effects.resolution: moveTo(x, y, board, false) swaps cells unconditionally (forcedDisplacement false, so canBeMoved is not consulted), sets the caster to the moving state and cooldown = 100. The line is collected before the swap.

effects.kind: shield (allies on the line, including self)
effects.scaling: requested amount = table value. addShield(value, caster, apBoost 1, crit): Big Eater Belt on the receiver x1.25 (rounded down) first (applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff), then x(1 + caster AP/100), then x critPower if the cast crit, then x0.5 if the receiver is enraged, then rounded; the shield stacks onto the existing shield and is only added if the receiver's hp > 0
effects.resolution: applied shield = round(table x [belt] x (1 + AP/100) x [crit] x [enraged]); a receiver at hp <= 0 gets nothing. The caster's shieldDone counter rises by the applied amount. If no destination was found the set is empty and the caster alone is added (self-only fallback).

effects.kind: cleanse (allies on the line, including self)
effects.resolution: Status.clearNegativeStatus(ally, caster) zeroes the cooldowns of burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armorReduction, locked and blind, sets curse false (adding 2000 ms to a running curse cooldown "on purpose"), and zeroes possessedCooldown except that a possessed ally is not freed when the caster is on its team (always true here, so possession is kept). The method has no runeProtect check. It runs BEFORE the shield for each ally. How the cleared cooldowns become removed flags (status update loop) and whether poison stacks reset were not read.

statusEffects.target: allies on the line including the caster
statusEffects.applicationOrder: per ally: cleanse first, then shield; after the move
statusEffects.guards: no runeProtect guard inside clearNegativeStatus; possession is kept for same-team possessors
statusEffects.combatEffect: not traced (status update loop not read)

shields.target: allies on the line including the caster
shields.requestedVsApplied: requested = table value; applied includes Big Eater Belt x1.25 (down), AP, crit, enraged x0.5, rounding

starBehavior.note: Indexed by the caster's stars; 3 stars (80) and 4 stars (160, also the fallback) are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts. maxPP 80, range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: Needs at least one ally other than the caster with a free adjacent cell (or any free cell, via the fallback) for the dash; otherwise self-only. The dash ends beyond the farthest ally, so the line usually crosses the allies in between. Allies adjacent to the line but not on a crossed cell are not hit.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast repeats the dash, cleanse and shield; shields stack.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested shield: 20 (Ponyta) / 40 (Rapidash). Applied per ally: round(table x [1.25 down if the receiver holds Big Eater Belt] x (1 + AP/100) x [critPower if crit] x [0.5 if the receiver is enraged]); the self-only fallback uses the same formula on the caster. The destination is the farthest-from-caster free cell next to the farthest ally unless the retained-selectedCell or closest-place fallback applies.
